description: Rust-based download manager with multi-connection downloads, browser integration, video and playlist downloads.
notes: The upstream v2.0.1 release build script packages the portable application under VeloxFetch-portable\ with velox-desktop.exe, velox-native-host.exe and optional bundled video-tools.
The portable copy has no uninstaller.exe, so the app identifies it as portable; its in-app update action opens the release page instead of running the NSIS installer.
The browser extension is installed separately through the browser store or the app's browser settings.
